name: itinerary
title: DRAFT travel itinerary
for_each: select id,code from tours.bookings where status<>'cancelled' order by code

sections.title: Booking
sections.sql: select code,name,travel_date,end_date,pax from tours.bookings where id=$1
sections.note: Confirm dates and passenger details before issuing.

sections.title: Services
sections.sql: select service_date,product,location,supplier,units,unit,status,confirmation_ref from tours.service_detail where booking_id=$1 and status<>'cancelled' order by service_date,code
sections.note: Requested services are not confirmed reservations.

name: rooming-list
title: DRAFT rooming list
for_each: select id,code from tours.bookings where status<>'cancelled' order by code

sections.title: Group
sections.sql: select code,name,pax from tours.bookings where id=$1
sections.note: Check the passenger count. This list contains only recorded names.

sections.title: Rooms
sections.sql: select code,name,room from tours.passengers where booking_id=$1 order by room,name
sections.note: Share only with the suppliers who need these details.

name: costing
title: DRAFT booking costing
for_each: select id,code from tours.bookings where status<>'cancelled' order by code

sections.title: Current services
sections.note: Service costing uses recorded exchange rates. Missing services are not zero-cost bookings.

sections.title: Imported snapshot
sections.note: Imported Tour Summary amounts are separate snapshots, not a ledger or live service total.

sections.title: Cost lines
sections.sql: select code,product,units,supplier_currency,(buy_cents::numeric/100) unit_buy_in_supplier_currency,fx,currency,cost_cents,revenue_cents from tours.service_detail where booking_id=$1 and status<>'cancelled' order by service_date,code
sections.note: Buy amounts are in supplier currency. Converted cost and revenue are in booking currency.

name: voucher
title: DRAFT supplier voucher
for_each: select id,code from tours.services where status='confirmed' order by code

sections.title: Confirmed service
sections.note: A draft document of an existing confirmation. Not sent and not authority to charge.
